examples: Learn what a light means before you start your first session: the status lights are the first thing on the documentation page.
Click a numbered mark on the settings picture to open the exact settings section it points at.
how_to: Open the documentation (menu tab, documentation, or the question mark at the foot of the drawer). The status lights are explained at the top, in a grid that stacks on a narrow screen.
Scroll to a picture. Hover or focus a numbered mark to read what that area is; click it, or press enter, to open the page it points at. The same marks are listed under the picture.
Edit the guide as markdown: one file per section in docs/user-guide/, then rebuild the web bundle. The file format is docs/user-guide/README.md.
name: Documentation user guide
summary: the documentation page is written as markdown, opens on the status lights, and carries screenshots with numbered click marks that open the part of the app they point at.
where: Menu tab, documentation; the question mark at the foot of the drawer.
The #docs link, or #docs/lights, #docs/start, #docs/terminals and #docs/settings for the pictures.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
